issues.en: The baptism date is written as the 'thirty-first' of April, which is as drafted (April has 30 days; likely a misreading). Parish priest (Настоятель) officiates. The child's first name 'Кзефа' is uncertain. The godmother's name and her husband's name are garbled. The family are nobles (Дворянъ).
issues.lt: Krikšto data „balandžio 31“ neįmanoma; mėnuo ar diena galėjo būti perskaityti klaidingai. Krikštamotės vardas ir jos vyro vardas bei pavardė neaiškūs.
